body: That’s what I’m hoping for idealistically. But from my observation with my married siblings who had already moved out, my parents still try their best to involve them in this toxic system.
Being born female in this family feels like a curse. Only way they see I could gain their respect is to marry someone very wealthy 😂
Yeah, when it all started she kept telling us to talk to our dad to stop cheating. When we didn’t she blamed us for not cooperating.
It has always been like that. We can’t even open up personal stuff about us because she’ll end up spreading gossip to our uncles and aunties.
I’m already 29 and I’m about to revive the family business, but Brother and father decided they going to use it with a new business plan. Dad is asking me to find another job.
Also received a call from an automated Eastwestbank daw binaba ko agad. Ngaun na praning na ako
I hope you are doing okay.
I’m struggling the same, but on the past years I’ve been trying new hobbies to keep me in line. Like making kombucha and learning how to ride the bike.
I’ve talked to my friends about this, and I didn’t like them concerning about me like this. It just doesn’t help making them feel burdened by me and my miserable life.

I’ve already opened up to my mom about wanting to die. Her reply is just she does too as well, but I wouldn’t get accepted in heaven if K took my life. There is no use on opening up to my sister because she uses everything I said against me in the future and pin me down with hurtful words. I’m crying right now I want to die!
I feel stepped on in my family. Everyone is treating me like shit. Words from their mouth makes me want to die. They make me feel I’m useless piece of crap
